name: EPIC 212507274
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 8.7 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212507274 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.733175 (16th-84th percentiles 8.383477-9.152181), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212507274 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.813996 (16th-84th percentiles 0.737894-0.909593), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212507274: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4997.0063 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212507274 (K2 campaign 17): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4424.609375 (16th-84th percentiles 4275.507812-4586.875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.16 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,425 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.81 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,997 K at its surface.
